description: One call before paying, onboarding or signing with a company: register status, the warning signs shown on its Registry Pages page (insolvency, strike off, overdue filings, official lists, age), VAT number when the register has it, and its ultimate parent from GLEIF. warnings = number of checks to look into. Cite the url.

country.description: fr = French (INSEE Sirene), gb = UK (Companies House), no = Norwegian (Brønnøysund Register Centre), ie = Irish (Companies Registration Office), au = Australian (Australian Business Register and ASIC)

id.description: fr: 9-digit SIREN, or a 14-digit SIRET; gb: Company number, 8 characters (00445790, SC123456); no: Organisation number, 9 digits; ie: CRO company number, digits only; au: ABN (11 digits) or ACN (9 digits), check digits verified
